TRACE_ASSERTIONS.ASSERTION: Corrupted blocks.json is reported through Storage::load_error instead of being silently treated as an empty index.
Full snapshot replacement removes stale file blocks and preserves searchable current blocks.
Per-file upsert can replace a file with zero blocks while preserving unrelated files.
Deleted-file removal removes only matching file paths and persists the delta.
Storage::db_path_for_root returns the same deterministic persisted index path used by Storage::new for GraphRAG cache signatures.
Filtered search applies language and path-prefix constraints before scoring/ranking.
Dense semantic vector search ranks compatible persisted embeddings and ignores incompatible model metadata.
N-gram vector fallback remains available when no compatible embeddings are present.
